description: This bar chart, titled “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis,” compares the accuracy of three sentiment analysis methods—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—across two categories: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet.” The vertical axis represents “Accuracy,” scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.8 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The horizontal axis lists the two categories being compared. For each category, there are three grouped bars: a white bar with no fill for TEXTBLOB, a black bar with diagonal hatching for VADER, and a solid green bar for ChatGPT. In the “Emoji Tweets” category, the accuracy values are approximately 0.3 for TEXTBLOB, 0.5 for VADER, and 0.7 for ChatGPT. In the “Overall Tweet” category, the accuracy values are approximately 0.3 for TEXTBLOB, 0.5 for VADER, and 0.7 for ChatGPT. The bars are arranged in groups with each method represented by a distinct color and pattern, and there is no sorting of bars by height; they are presented in the order specified by the legend. The chart includes a legend in the bottom right corner identifying each method by its corresponding bar style.
